# Lians

Lians is the evidence layer for production AI.

It receives OpenTelemetry traces from AI agents, models, tools, retrieval, and human review and preserves them as governed, replayable records.

Core public pages:

- Product: https://www.lians.ai/product
- Optional community Grafana integration: https://www.lians.ai/integrations
- Documentation: https://www.lians.ai/docs
- Pricing and pilots: https://www.lians.ai/pricing
- Source: https://github.com/Lians-ai/Lians

Integration status:

- The authenticated OTLP/HTTP receiver is implemented.
- The community Grafana adapter is optional and is not part of the core Lians workflow.
- The adapter is buildable source and is not catalog-listed, reviewed, approved, or endorsed by Grafana Labs.

Lians is OpenTelemetry-native, open source, and self-hostable.
